proposed_budget_ceilings_not_permit.singleton_bypass_rule: Single-candidate decisions use SINGLETON_BYPASS and consume 0 model sends.

stop_rules: STOP_NO_PHYSICAL_CANDIDATE: current state candidate pool empty; stop current job immediately.
PREDICTED_STATIC_INSTABILITY: monitor returns UNSTABLE; do not place failed box, stop current job immediately.
STABILITY_UNASSESSABLE / STABILITY_MONITOR_ERROR: stop current job immediately; do not merge into predicted instability.
UNKNOWN_SEND / PROVIDER_FAILURE / INVALID_RESPONSE / BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: stop current job immediately (and halt batch on first technical/unknown-send error); never implicitly retry.
GEOMETRY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED / PHYSICAL_CHECK_DISAGREEMENT / RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH: stop immediately as technical failure; never fall back from EMS to E2.
